title: GOV-0001: main is not PR-only; the Issue→WP→PR chain has never existed
problem:
## Observed
- `main` refuses a direct push only because `governance` is a required status check that has never reported on a push commit. No rule requires a PR. If that check ever reported on a push, `main` would open. (Measured: classic protection carries 6 of 11 §8 rules; `require PR` absent; rulesets: 0.)
- Every PR to date (#1–#18) was merged with `--merge`; `main` holds 18 merge commits over 23 real commits. Three merge methods were allowed.
- 23 non-merge commits on `main`: **0 reference a GitHub Issue.** 10 reference a Work Package, 10 a Decision. This repository has had **zero Issues, ever.** Every WP's demand was a chat message.

## Expected
The BADF GitHub control plane: Issue → (Research) → Work Package → Branch → Draft PR → Verified Merge → `main`. `main` is the accepted integration ledger, never a workspace. No actor bypasses.

## Evidence
`gh api repos/bstBizEra/badf/branches/main/protection`, `gh api repos/bstBizEra/badf/rulesets` (empty), `git log --merges | wc -l` = 18, `gh issue list --state all` = 0. Measured 2026-08-28 before any change.

## Unknowns
Whether a single-collaborator repository can satisfy `required_approving_review_count >= 1` without making every PR permanently unmergeable. (Known from secb_pf: it cannot. Deviation from §8 to be recorded, not hidden.)

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0016` — P0 items: active ruleset with no bypass; squash-only + auto-merge; `BADF-MAIN-001` as normative doc stating this repository's own prior non-compliance; a traceability check on PR bodies (`Work-Package:` + `Closes #N`).

## Scope boundary
Issue Forms, PR template, Draft-PR workflow, research agent, learning reconciliation: **out of scope** (P1–P3), separate Issues.

*This is the first Issue this repository has ever had (it is #19 because PRs and Issues share a number space). It exists so the doctrine's first link exists before the doctrine claims it.*
note: Body exported verbatim from the GitHub Issue and digest-bound. The Issue is the source; this record is what the gate verifies offline. Closed by PR #20 (squash 12f5056).
